title: Symlink guard in libs/skinny/setup.py and libs/tracing/setup.py must be changed together
answers: keep skinny and tracing build checks in sync
body:
The two guard files are near-identical copies that differ only in the directory name in the error text (libs/skinny vs libs/tracing) and the docstring package name.
When changing the check condition, the error message, or the git clone hint, apply the same edit to both libs/skinny/setup.py and libs/tracing/setup.py.
Both point at the same repo-level mlflow package, so the clone instruction must stay identical in both files.
The mechanism is duplication with no shared module, so divergence is silent; no test or CI job builds either variant on Windows to catch it.
applies: Edits to either libs/skinny or libs/tracing build guard.
says: The repository clone advice shown during lightweight package build errors is inconsistent.
Update the build validation error message and clone hint for lightweight client packages.
Lightweight client and tracing package build checks display differing clone guidance on failure.
Synchronize the source clone instructions shown when lightweight package builds fail.
search: Any changes to check conditions, error messages, or git clone hints in the symlink build guards must be applied identically to both libs/skinny/setup.py and libs/tracing/setup.py. Because the duplicated files share no common module and differ only in package and directory names, divergence is silent and undetected by CI Windows builds.
